baseline_models.focus_anchor: استفزز من استطعت منهم بصوتك وأجلب عليهم بخيلك ورجلك
baseline_models.mechanism: The imperatives form a staged capture pipeline: shake a target out of stability, reach the ear, aggregate pressure, then deploy mounted and foot agents across complementary ranges.

activation_trace.role: Lightness that shakes stability supplies dislodgment and functions as the pipeline's opening disturbance.
Audible sound, including shouting, supplies the contact channel and functions as the first means of reach.
Shouting and gathering against someone supplies collective pressure and functions as organized mobilization.
Horses and riders supply mounted range and function as the fast arm of the mobilized force.
Walking on foot supplies dismounted presence and functions as the force that reaches where mounted movement does not.

changed_reading.before: The verse lists several separate tactics of temptation and attack.
changed_reading.after: The verse scripts an escalation from destabilizing attention through audible recruitment to organized, full-range deployment.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: وشاركهم في الأموال والأولاد وعدهم وما يعدهم الشيطان إلا غرورا
baseline_models.mechanism: The attack matures from external pressure into embedded participation: it enters holdings and generative continuity as a co-producing share, while promised benefit and prepared means make the arrangement attractive and unstable deception hides its cost.

activation_trace.role: A thing held between partners supplies literal shared participation and functions as entry into the target's own systems.
Possessed and accumulated wealth supplies the material stock and functions as one host system for participation.
Offspring and descendants supply generational continuity and function as the second host system.
A spoken promise that opens hope supplies anticipated benefit and functions as consent-producing projection.
Preparing equipment and reserves supplies a split-root image of readiness and functions as the material underside of promised action.
Deception by what shines but does not remain supplies unstable attraction and functions as concealment of the partnership's cost.

changed_reading.before: The adversary merely takes property, corrupts children, and tells lies.
changed_reading.after: The adversary seeks durable insertion into production, inheritance, and expectation, turning the target's own continuity into a carrier of influence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The image of tiny units dispersing sharpens offspring from a private family object into a distributed transmission field; participation in children can propagate influence across descendants rather than end with one recruited person.

activation_trace.role: Shared participation supplies entry into another's sphere and functions as the mode of intergenerational embedding.
Offspring supply the explicit focus anchor and function as the line through which participation persists.
Small particles and their dispersal supply a distributed image and function as the context trigger for lineage-wide propagation.

structural_cues: 17:62 places branchless ح ن ك at word 12 directly over ذرية at word 13 in the adversary's announced aim.
The focus moves from mobilizing those presently reachable to participation in offspring, extending the operation beyond an immediate encounter.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a threat aimed at progeny and a dispersal branch for ذرية; I infer that dispersion makes children a transmission network for the focus partnership. A live alternative is that ذرية only names the aggregate descendants without implying a mechanism of diffusion.

changed_reading.before: Sharing in children means influence over individual children within a household.
changed_reading.after: Sharing in children becomes intergenerational distribution: capture reproduces itself through a lineage.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus promise projects gain without stable delivery, while the context supplies complete recompense and a written, readable record. غرور therefore detaches imagined benefit from the consequence ledger rather than merely stating an isolated falsehood.

activation_trace.role: A promise opening hope supplies the projected future and functions as the misleading side of the temporal contrast.
Risk with an unknown outcome supplies concealed uncertainty and functions as the gap between promise and consequence.
An act met by its recompense supplies consequence and functions as the answer to the promise's unpriced projection.
Completeness without deficiency supplies full measure and functions as the refusal of any hidden discount in consequence.
An inscription that establishes a binding judgment supplies durable record and functions as the counter-ledger.
Reading and recitation supply disclosed access to the record and function as eventual exposure of what the promise concealed.

structural_cues: 17:63 immediately associates following the adversary with a fully abundant recompense.
17:71 presents each group's book as readable and denies even the smallest injustice.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies deceptive promise, full recompense, and an adjudicating book; I infer a contrast between unpriced projection and accounted outcome. A live alternative is that the recompense and book frame the episode eschatologically without specifying how the promise deceives.

changed_reading.after: The adversary sells a future severed from its ledger, making concealed consequence itself the mechanism of غرور.

context_deltas.mechanism: من استطعت delimits a field of susceptibility, and the following negation of authority recasts voice, mobilization, partnership, and promise as inducements that recruit agency rather than irresistible commands.

activation_trace.role: Capacity and enablement supply the limit in whom the adversary can reach and function as a boundary on the operation.
Shaking stability supplies pressure and functions as inducement short of ownership of the target's will.
Participation between parties supplies relational entry and functions as recruited complicity rather than unilateral possession.
Power and governing authority supply the explicitly negated capacity and function as the limit distinguishing persuasion from sovereignty.
One who sufficiently guards an affair supplies protective administration and functions as the counter-agency to adversarial recruitment.

structural_cues: 17:65 immediately negates سلطان over God's servants after the focus command.
The same ayah closes with the sufficiency of the Lord as وكيل, opposing guarded agency to adversarial participation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a capacity clause, negated authority, and sufficient guardianship; I infer that the focus methods depend on elicited response rather than coercive sovereignty. A live alternative is that the negation applies only to the protected servant subset and leaves the general mode of influence unspecified.

changed_reading.before: The imperatives grant the adversary direct power to overpower whomever he attacks.
changed_reading.after: The imperatives authorize attempts at recruitment and destabilization within a bounded field, while effective agency remains contestable and guardable.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context's gently driven vessel, carrying across land and sea, apportioned provision, and human lineage turn the focus's transport and partnership terms into a circulation model: hostile influence does not create life's channels but enters and redirects channels of mobility, goods, and descent.

activation_trace.role: Driving and bringing things from place to place supplies circulation and functions as the focus-side logistical anchor.
Held wealth supplies circulating material value and functions as one channel open to parasitic participation.
Descendants supply human continuity and function as the lineage channel paired with material circulation.
Gentle driving and conveyance supply legitimate directed movement and function as the context trigger for circulation.
Filial relation and attribution to an origin supply lineage structure and function as the legitimate human continuity being entered.
Bearing a visible load supplies transport and functions as the legitimate mobility channel contrasted with hostile mobilization.
Apportioned provision supplies granted goods and functions as the legitimate source whose circulation can be parasitized.

structural_cues: 17:66 joins driven transport in the sea to seeking divine bounty.
17:70 joins بني آدم, carriage on land and sea, and provision from good things in one sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies legitimate movement, carriage, provision, and lineage alongside the focus's mobilization and sharing; I infer that the adversarial operation parasitizes pre-existing channels instead of originating them. A live alternative is that the transport sequence is only a nearby contrast and does not define the mechanics of participation.

changed_reading.before: Cavalry, foot forces, wealth, and children are separate military and domestic targets.
changed_reading.after: They form one infrastructure of circulation and continuity whose legitimate flows can be entered, redirected, and made to carry hostile participation.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later pressure shows how the focus pipeline can move from public voice to private accommodation: incline someone from a received message, offer a fabricated substitute, reward it with penetrating intimacy, and seek even a slight lean; stabilization blocks the sequence.

activation_trace.role: Shaking settledness supplies the focus pressure and functions as the condition under which a slight lean becomes possible.
Promise opening hope supplies prospective reward and functions as the attraction paired with pressure.
Inclining away from truth supplies directional pressure and functions as the context's explicit recruitment vector.
Fabricating a lie supplies substitute speech and functions as the content the pressure seeks to produce.
Affection that penetrates the self supplies intimate access and functions as the social reward for accommodation.
Strengthening something into stability supplies the counterforce and functions as interruption of destabilization.
Leaning and settling toward something supplies the near-yield and functions as the measurable endpoint of pressure.

structural_cues: 17:73 sequences attempted diversion, fabrication, and being taken as an intimate friend.
17:74 pairs a near slight lean with prior divine stabilization.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies diversion, fabricated replacement, promised intimacy, near-leaning, and stabilization; I infer that these expose a social-persuasion path inside the focus's voice and promise. A live alternative is that 17:73-74 describes analogous human pressure rather than the adversary's direct operating chain.

changed_reading.before: Voice and promise work mainly as broad public propaganda.
changed_reading.after: They can culminate in intimate negotiated accommodation: altered speech is exchanged for belonging, and stability is the point under attack.

context_deltas.mechanism: The exact focus root reappears with land and expulsion, resolving the lightness that shakes stability toward spatial and political dislodgment: agitation is successful when a person is moved off settled ground and out of place.

activation_trace.role: Shaking stability supplies the focus action and functions as the initial removal from settledness.
The same shaking-displacement image occurs with removal from land and functions as the decisive contextual specification.
The lower ground called land supplies concrete place and functions as the stability from which the target is dislodged.
Passing to the outside supplies expulsion and functions as the spatial endpoint of destabilization.

structural_cues: 17:76 states ليستفزونك من الأرض ليخرجوك منها, placing the repeated root directly before land-removal and exit.
The following clause gives the expellers only a short stay afterward, preserving destabilization as reciprocal rather than permanent sovereignty.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated focus root in an explicit land-to-exit construction; I infer that spatial dislodgment specifies a latent endpoint of the earlier command. A live alternative is that focus استفزز remains primarily psychological agitation while 17:76 realizes only one context-specific use.

changed_reading.before: استفزز means unsettle or incite people internally.
changed_reading.after: Its destabilization has a concrete endpoint: detach persons from settled ground, allegiance, or place until agitation becomes expulsion.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because cavalry and mobilization are not weather glosses. It remains valid as a focus-anchored branch constellation: a mountain-like cloud without water, a rain portent, a promising sign, and unstable glitter converge on four focus roots. Render it only as an exploratory metaphorical overlay, never as a replacement translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: أجلب عليهم بخيلك ... وعدهم ... إلا غرورا

activation_trace.role: A thin cloud appearing like a mountain yet holding no water supplies an imposing empty front and functions as the false display.
A cloud portent from which rain is hoped supplies anticipated provision and functions as the expectation generated by the display.
A promising sign from which a future condition is expected supplies forecast and functions as the display's claim about what will arrive.
What gleams but does not remain supplies deceptive appearance and functions as the exposure of the rain-front promise as empty.

changed_reading.before: The cavalry image and the promises are separate instruments of force and speech.
changed_reading.after: They also form a false-weather front: an imposing sign appears to promise life-bearing arrival, but the apparent cloud carries no water and resolves as غرور.

strongest_changes: The repeated ف ز ز in 17:76 gives focus destabilization a concrete endpoint in dislodgment and expulsion.
The negated سلطان in 17:65 recasts the operation as bounded inducement and recruited participation rather than coercive sovereignty.
The promise is revised into an unpriced future opposed by complete recompense and a readable counter-ledger.
Wealth and offspring become linked channels of legitimate circulation and continuity that hostile participation can parasitize.
summary.what_was_special: The packet's strongest lexical echo was the focus root ف ز ز reappearing in an explicit land-expulsion construction. The most unusual focus-only activation was the coherent empty-rain-front constellation across ج ل ب, خ ي ل, و ع د, and غ ر ر.
remaining_uncertainties: The circulation model is mechanically coherent but may remain a nearby contextual analogy rather than a direct specification of the focus.
The lineage-diffusion model depends on carrying the ذر ر dispersal image into ذرية without replacing its ordinary descendant reference.
The false-rain-front model should remain an exploratory branch-image overlay because its weather senses are form-distant from the surface military construction.
